name: io.github.wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
title: Apify External Business Intelligence MCP Server
description: 8 external-intel tools & 6 prompts: B2B site audits, stockists, Shopify, SOC 2 & K-Beauty.

tools.name: extract_brand_store_stockists
tools.description: Extract physical retail stockists and independent boutiques carrying external competitor brands (Stockist, Storepoint, StoreRocket, Storemapper, WP Store Locator, JSON-LD, HTML) and enrich each retailer website with buyer/wholesale emails (including Cloudflare decoding), Instagram, LinkedIn, independent-vs-chain classification, and 0-100 outreachReadinessScore ($5/1K stores; $0 when empty or filtered). Use for wholesale retail prospecting; do not use for editing your own store locator map or enriching corporate SaaS companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

urls.description: Competitor brand homepages or store locator URLs, e.g. ["https://fellowproducts.com", "https://brooklynhotdogcompany.com"]. Optional when datasetId is provided.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID containing brand or store locator URLs.

enrichEmails.description: Visit each unique retailer website (plus /wholesale and /contact) to extract buyer emails and social links.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only stores where at least one valid email is found ($0 otherwise).

onlyIndependentStores.description: When true, skip national chains (Target, Walmart, Sephora, Whole Foods, etc.) at $0 and return independent boutiques and regional shops.

maxStoresPerBrand.description: Maximum stockist locations to return per brand (1-5,000).

countryFilter.description: Optional country code or name filter, e.g. "US", "GB", "CA", "AU", "DE", or "KR".

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum outreachReadinessScore (0-100) required to save and bill ($0 for filtered stores).

tools.name: monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas
tools.description: Monitor up to 50 external Shopify competitor stores (up to 2,500 products each = 125K SKUs) for price drops, price hikes, restocks, stockouts, new launches, and MAP violations using persistent Key-Value Store snapshots ($2/1K real deltas; $0 on baseline or unchanged runs). Returns severity (CRITICAL, INVENTORY, CATALOG), oldPrice, newPrice, priceChangePercent, mapViolation, and productUrl. Use for tracking external Shopify competitors; do not use for editing your own Shopify admin or non-Shopify sites.

storeUrls.description: List of 1 to 50 external Shopify store or collection URLs, e.g. ["https://www.allbirds.com"].

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store (alphanumeric and hyphens only) used to persist snapshots between runs.

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum products to fetch per store URL (50-2,500, paginated at 250/page).

minPriceChangePercent.description: Minimum percentage change threshold (0-100) before emitting price_drop or price_increase.

eventTypes.description: Optional subset of catalog or pricing event types to emit.

mapThresholds.description: Optional map of SKU or product handle to Minimum Advertised Price (flags mapViolation: true and severity: CRITICAL if below threshold).

emitBaselineSummary.description: Emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary on the first snapshot of each store.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified when at least 1 delta occurs.

tools.name: audit_saas_trust_center
tools.description: Audit or monitor up to 500 external SaaS vendor Trust Centers (Vanta, Drata, SafeBase, Conveyor, Whistic, Secureframe, OneTrust) for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS certifications, DNS IAM/SSO, 75+ third-party and AI subprocessors (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI), complianceScore (0-100), and missingSoc2Lead ($5/1K audits or real changes; $0 unchanged). Use for third-party vendor risk (TPRM) or finding SaaS prospects missing SOC 2; do not use for editing your own internal GRC workspace.

domains.description: List of 1 to 500 external SaaS vendor or prospect domains, e.g. ["apify.com", "linear.app"].

mode.description: "audit" returns complete security posture immediately; "monitor" compares against snapshots and emits only real changes ($0 unchanged).

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist baseline snapshots in monitor mode.

checkSubprocessors.description: Inspect /subprocessors pages and Trust Center content for third-party and AI vendors.

checkDnsIam.description: Query DNS CNAME/TXT/MX records to verify Trust Center hosting and SSO/IAM providers.

tools.name: enrich_b2b_company_leads
tools.description: Read-only 3-in-1 B2B company enricher: resolve company names, domains, work emails, or an Apify datasetId into verified official domain, LinkedIn /company/ URL (rejecting /in/ noise), Cloudflare-decoded corporate emails (sales@, contact@, hello@), WhatsApp links, phones, 6 social profiles, and 0-100 leadQualityScore ($2.50/1K enriched; $0 for misses, parked domains, or onlyWithEmail skips). Use for B2B corporate enrichment; do not use for influencer/creator bios (use enrich_creator_bio_leads instead).

inputs.description: Up to 2,000 company names, domains, URLs, or work emails, e.g. ["Stripe", "Linear", "apify.com"]. Optional when datasetId is provided.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID (auto-detects website, domain, companyName, name, or email fields).

datasetField.description: Optional explicit field name to read from datasetId items when chaining.

enrichContactPages.description: Follow up to 2 internal /contact or /about pages when the homepage lacks emails or LinkedIn.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only companies where at least 1 verified email is found ($0 otherwise).

includeUnresolved.description: Include unresolved/not_found rows in the dataset for auditability (always $0 cost).

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for accepting company-name-to-domain matches.

tools.name: enrich_creator_bio_leads
tools.description: Read-only creator enricher across 15+ Link-in-Bio platforms (Linktree, Stan.store, Bio.site, Beacons, Komi, Hoo.be, Carrd, etc.). Extracts talent agency and business emails (with 1-hop personal site following + Cloudflare email decoding), phones/WhatsApp, 14 social networks, monetization links, promo codes, and 0-100 Creator Readiness Score ($2.50/1K enriched; $0 for 404/WAF/no-email skips). Use for influencer and UGC sponsorship outreach; do not use for corporate B2B companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

urls.description: List of creator Link-in-Bio URLs or handles, e.g. ["https://linktr.ee/heathertraska", "https://stan.store/stan"]. Optional when datasetId is provided.

datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID from an upstream Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube scraper (preserves upstreamHandle and upstreamFollowers).

enableDeepContactFollow.description: When no email is on the bio page, follow up to 2 personal website, Contact, or Media Kit links (1-hop, SSRF-safe, Cloudflare decoding included).

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only creators with at least 1 valid email ($0 when missing).

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum Creator Brand-Deal Readiness Score (0-100) required to save and bill.

maxProfiles.description: Maximum unique creator bio URLs to process (1-50,000).

maxConcurrency.description: Concurrent requests (1-20; capped automatically on 128-256 MB containers).

tools.name: search_korea_mfds_recalls
tools.description: Read-only search of official South Korea MFDS (식약처) cosmetic recall and sales suspension orders in plain English or Korean (auto-bridges 50+ K-Beauty terms like "sunscreen", "soap", "Cosmax"). Returns productName, companyName, isActiveRecall, lotNumber, recallReason, recallOrderDate, and businessNumber ($3/1K matches; $0 if none). Use for K-Beauty import safety and recall compliance screening; do not use for US FDA/EU recalls or functional OEM factory discovery (use search_korea_mfds_oem_filings instead).

companyName.description: Optional brand or manufacturer filter in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Cowell", or "코스맥스".

productName.description: Optional product keyword in English or Korean, e.g. "sunscreen", "soap", "lip balm", or "선크림".

onlyActiveRecalls.description: When true, return and bill only currently active recall orders (hiding expired notices at $0).

businessNumber.description: Optional Korean 10-digit business registration number (hyphens ignored), e.g. "2158733119".

recallOrderDateFrom.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2025-01-01".

recallOrderDateTo.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-12-31".

tools.name: search_korea_mfds_oem_filings
tools.description: Read-only search across 219,000+ official South Korea MFDS functional cosmetic filings in plain English or Korean ("sunscreen", "retinol cream", "Cosmax", "Kolmar" auto-bridge to Korean queries). Auto-joins reviewed base formulas to uncover hidden Korean OEM/ODM factories, SPF/PA ratings, and English functionalClaims ($2/1K records; $0 if empty). Use for K-Beauty OEM sourcing and regulatory R&D; do not use for recall checks (use search_korea_mfds_recalls instead).

datasetType.description: Which MFDS registry to query: "reported" (198k+ brand filings), "reviewed" (20k+ OEM base formulas), or "both".

productName.description: Product keyword in English or Korean (e.g. "sunscreen", "retinol cream", "serum", "선크림") — English auto-translates server-side.

brandOrDistributor.description: Brand or responsible seller in English or Korean, e.g. "Amorepacific", "Olive Young", "Medicube", or "아모레퍼시픽".

oemManufacturer.description: OEM/ODM factory in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Kolmar", "Cosmecca", or "코스맥스".

efficacyKeyword.description: Efficacy claim filter in English or Korean: "whitening", "anti-wrinkle", "uv-protection", "SPF", "hair-loss", "미백", "주름".

itemCode.description: Exact MFDS ITEM_SEQ or COSMETIC_REPORT_SEQ identifier for single-product lookup.

resolveOemFromReviewed.description: Query linked reviewed base formulas automatically to reveal hidden OEM/ODM factories when missing on reported filings.

tools.name: audit_local_b2b_websites
tools.description: Read-only all-in-one agency lead auditor: accept Google Maps Apify datasetId, up to 2,000 company website URLs, or 13 live-verified US Chamber of Commerce presets, and run an 8-point website weakness X-ray (HTTPS/SSL, mobile viewport, load speed, outdated copyright year, SEO/LocalBusiness schema, GA4/GTM/Meta/TikTok pixels, booking/chat widgets, CMS), Cloudflare-decoded owner email recovery, 0-100 pitchPriorityScore, and factual cold-email subject & icebreaker ($4.50/1K leads; $0 on optional filtered misses). Use for web design, local SEO, paid ads, and AI chatbot agency prospecting; do not use for SaaS SOC 2 Trust Center security audits (use audit_saas_trust_center instead).

websiteUrls.description: Optional list of up to 2,000 local business website URLs to audit, e.g. ["https://ddofoods.com"].

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID (e.g. from Google Maps Scraper) to chain leads directly, preserving no_website VIP leads.

presetChambers.description: Optional verified US Chamber of Commerce city presets to auto-collect paying local businesses.

chamberDirectoryUrls.description: Optional custom ChamberMaster / GrowthZone directory URLs.

chamberCategoryKeyword.description: Optional category keyword filter for Chamber directories (e.g. "dental", "plumbing", "restaurant", "roofing").

agencyPreset.description: Agency service vertical used to weight pitchPriorityScore and tailor coldEmailSubject & coldEmailIcebreaker.

enableContactPageFollow.description: Follow up to 1 internal /contact or /about page when the homepage lacks an email.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only leads where an email is found ($0 otherwise).

onlyWithWeakness.description: When true, skip polished websites with 0 detected weaknesses at $0.

minPitchScore.description: Minimum 0-100 pitchPriorityScore required to save and bill ($0 below threshold).

maxItems.description: Maximum total leads to audit and save (1-2,000).
